websearch.provider.deepseek.desc: DeepSeek's official Search / Fetch endpoints, authenticated with a DeepSeek API key. Supports page content and single-page fetch.
websearch.provider.tavily.desc: Search API built for AI. Supports page content and the Extract endpoint for single pages.
websearch.provider.brave.desc: Brave's independent Web Search API. Search results only, no fetch endpoint.
websearch.provider.exa.desc: Search API built for AI. Supports highlights, page content and the Contents endpoint for single pages.
websearch.provider.serpapi.desc: Google results through SerpApi (organic_results). Search results only, no fetch endpoint.
panel_websearch.title: Web Search Settings
panel_websearch.desc: Configure API keys, default result count and timeout for web search services. API keys are stored locally in KVData only.
panel_websearch.active_provider_hint: Used whenever a node does not pick a service itself.
panel_websearch.max_results_hint: 1 ~ 50. Default number of results for the auto search node and the search tool.
panel_websearch.max_content_chars_hint: Maximum characters of page content per result injected into the context or returned to the model. 0 disables truncation.
panel_websearch.max_fetch_chars_hint: Maximum characters of page content returned by the fetch tool. 0 disables truncation.
panel_websearch.include_content_hint: Also request page content while searching (slower and larger responses; only some services support it).
panel_websearch.language_hint: Only supported by some services (Tavily / Brave / SerpApi).
panel_websearch.country_hint: Only supported by some services (Brave / SerpApi).
panel_websearch.providers_desc: Fill in an API key per service. A custom API base URL is optional and falls back to the official endpoint when empty.
panel_websearch.test_desc: Saves the current form and runs one real search to verify the API key and network access.
panel_websearch.msg_invalid_max_results: Result count must be an integer between {0} and {1}.
panel_websearch.msg_invalid_timeout: Timeout must be an integer between {0} and {1} seconds.
panel_websearch.msg_invalid_max_content_: Max content per result must be an integer of 0 or greater.
panel_websearch.msg_invalid_max_fetch_ch: Max fetched content must be an integer of 0 or greater.
panel_websearch.msg_test_no_results: The request succeeded but the query returned no results.
